statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.2
statements.object: risks due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted
statements.object_as_written: risks due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted
statements.object_normalised: risks due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted
statements.quote: The aim of protective measures shall be to eliminate any risk throughout the foreseeable lifetime of the machinery or related product including the phases of transport, assembly, dismantling, disabling and scrapping. (b) In selecting the most appropriate methods, the manufacturer shall apply the following principles, in the order given: (i) eliminate hazards or, if that is not possible, minimise risks (inherently safe machinery or related product design and construction); (ii) take the necessary protective measures in relation to risks that cannot be eliminated; (iii) inform users of the residual risks due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted, indicate whether any particular training is required and specify any need to provide personal protective equipment. (c) When designing and constructing machinery or a related product and when drafting the instructions for use, the manufacturer shall envisage not only the intended use of the machinery or related product but also any reasonably foreseeable misuse thereof.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.2
statements.object: abnormal use
statements.object_as_written: abnormal use
statements.object_normalised: abnormal use
statements.condition: if such use would engender a risk
statements.quote: The machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent abnormal use if such use would engender a risk.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.3
statements.object: risks due to filling
statements.object_as_written: risks due to filling
statements.object_normalised: risks due to filling
statements.quote: In particular, where fluids are used, machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed to prevent risks due to filling, use, recovery or draining.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.6
statements.object: fatigue and physical and psychological stress faced by the operator
statements.object_as_written: fatigue and physical and psychological stress faced by the operator
statements.object_normalised: fatigue and physical and psychological stress faced by the operator
statements.quote: Ergonomics Under the intended conditions of use, the discomfort, fatigue and physical and psychological stress faced by the operator shall be eliminated or reduced to the minimum possible, taking into account at least, the following ergonomic principles: (a) allowing for the variability of the operator’s physical dimensions, strength and stamina; (b) avoiding the need for demanding work postures or movements and manual force exertions that exceed the operator’s capacity; (c) providing enough space for movements of the parts of the operator’s body; (d) avoiding a machine-determined work rate; (e) avoiding monitoring that requires lengthy concentration; (f) adapting the human-machine interface to the foreseeable characteristics of the operators, including with respect to machinery or a related product with intended fully or partially self-evolving behaviour or logic that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy; (g) where relevant, adapting machinery or a related product with intended fully or partially self-evolving behaviour or logic that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy to respond to people adequately and appropriately (such as verbally through words and non-verbally through gestures, facial expressions or body movement) and to communicate its planned actions (such as what it is going to do and why) to operators in a comprehensible manner.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.7
statements.object: risk due to exhaust gases or lack of oxygen
statements.object_as_written: risk due to exhaust gases or lack of oxygen
statements.object_normalised: risk due to exhaust gases or lack of oxygen
statements.quote: Operating positions The operating position shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to avoid any risk due to exhaust gases or lack of oxygen.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.1.8
statements.object: stresses to which they can be subjected
statements.object_as_written: stresses to which they can be subjected
statements.object_normalised: stresses to which they can be subjected
statements.quote: The seat mountings shall withstand all stresses to which they can be subjected.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.2.1
statements.object: hazardous situations from arising
statements.object_as_written: hazardous situations from arising
statements.object_normalised: hazardous situations from arising
statements.quote: Safety and reliability of control systems Control systems shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent hazardous situations from arising.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.2.1
statements.object: stresses and intended and unintended external influences
statements.object_as_written: stresses and intended and unintended external influences
statements.object_normalised: stresses and intended and unintended external influences
statements.condition: where appropriate to the circumstances and the risks
statements.quote: Control systems shall be designed and constructed in such a way that: (a) they can withstand, where appropriate to the circumstances and the risks, the intended operating stresses and intended and unintended external influences, including reasonably foreseeable malicious attempts from third parties leading to a hazardous situation; (b) a fault in the hardware or the logic of the control system shall not lead to hazardous situations; (c) errors in the control system logic shall not lead to hazardous situations; (d) the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part of the risk assessment performed by the manufacturer and no modifications are allowed to the settings or rules generated by the machinery or related product or by operators, including during the machinery or related product learning phase, where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations; (e) reasonably foreseeable human errors during operation shall not lead to hazardous situations; (f) the tracing log of the data generated in relation to an intervention and of the versions of safety software uploaded after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service is enabled for five years after such upload, exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.2
statements.object: stresses to which they
statements.object_as_written: stresses to which they
statements.object_normalised: stresses to which they
statements.quote: Risk of break-up during operation The various parts of machinery or related products and their linkages shall be able to withstand the stresses to which they are subject when used.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.2
statements.object: risk of rupture or disintegration
statements.object_as_written: risk of rupture or disintegration
statements.object_normalised: risk of rupture or disintegration
statements.condition: Where a risk of rupture or disintegration remains despite the measures taken
statements.quote: Where a risk of rupture or disintegration remains despite the measures taken, the parts concerned shall be mounted, positioned or guarded in such a way that any fragments will be contained, preventing hazardous situations.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.3
statements.object: risks from falling or ejected objects
statements.object_as_written: risks from falling or ejected objects
statements.object_normalised: risks from falling or ejected objects
statements.quote: Risks due to falling or ejected objects Precautions shall be taken to prevent risks from falling or ejected objects.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.4
statements.object: Risks due to surfaces
statements.object_as_written: Risks due to surfaces
statements.object_normalised: risks due to surfaces
statements.quote: Risks due to surfaces, edges or angles Insofar as their purpose allows, accessible parts of the machinery or a related product shall have no sharp edges, no sharp angles and no rough surfaces likely to cause injury.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.7
statements.object: risks of contact which could lead to accidents
statements.object_as_written: risks of contact which could lead to accidents
statements.object_normalised: risks of contact which could lead to accidents
statements.quote: Risks related to moving parts The moving parts of the machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent risks of contact which could lead to accidents or shall, where risks persist, be fitted with guards or protective devices.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.7
statements.object: accidental blockage of moving parts
statements.object_as_written: accidental blockage of moving parts
statements.object_normalised: accidental blockage of moving parts
statements.quote: All necessary steps shall be taken to prevent accidental blockage of moving parts.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.7
statements.object: risks of contact leading to hazardous situations
statements.object_as_written: risks of contact leading to hazardous situations
statements.object_normalised: risks of contact leading to hazardous situations
statements.quote: The prevention of risks of contact leading to hazardous situations and the psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery shall be adapted to: (a) human-machine coexistence in a shared space without direct collaboration; (b) human-machine interaction.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.3.7
statements.object: psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery
statements.object_as_written: psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery
statements.object_normalised: psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery
statements.quote: The prevention of risks of contact leading to hazardous situations and the psychological stress that may be caused by the interaction with the machinery shall be adapted to: (a) human-machine coexistence in a shared space without direct collaboration; (b) human-machine interaction.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.4.2.2
statements.object: risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.object_as_written: risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.object_normalised: risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased
statements.quote: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased, movable guards shall be associated with a guard locking device in addition to an interlocking device that: (a) prevents the start of hazardous machinery or related product functions until the guard is closed and locked; and (b) keeps the guard closed and locked until the risk of injury from the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.4.2.2
statements.object: risk of injury from the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.object_as_written: risk of injury from the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.object_normalised: risk of injury from the hazardous machinery or related product functions
statements.condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased
statements.quote: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased, movable guards shall be associated with a guard locking device in addition to an interlocking device that: (a) prevents the start of hazardous machinery or related product functions until the guard is closed and locked; and (b) keeps the guard closed and locked until the risk of injury from the hazardous machinery or related product functions has ceased.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5
statements.object: Risks due to other causes
statements.object_as_written: Risks due to other causes
statements.object_normalised: risks due to other causes
statements.quote: Risks due to other causes

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.5
statements.object: risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product
statements.object_as_written: risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product
statements.object_normalised: risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product
statements.quote: Extreme temperatures Steps shall be taken to eliminate any risk of injury arising from contact with or proximity to machinery or related product parts or materials at high or very low temperatures.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.6
statements.object: risk of fire or overheating presented by the machinery or related product itself
statements.object_as_written: risk of fire or overheating presented by the machinery or related product itself
statements.object_normalised: risk of fire or overheating presented by the machinery or related product itself
statements.quote: Fire Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to avoid any risk of fire or overheating presented by the machinery or related product itself or by gases, liquids, dust, vapours or other substances produced or used by the machinery or related product.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.7
statements.object: risk of explosion presented by the machinery or related product itself or by gases
statements.object_as_written: risk of explosion presented by the machinery or related product itself or by gases
statements.object_normalised: risk of explosion presented by the machinery or related product itself or by gases
statements.quote: Explosion Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to avoid any risk of explosion presented by the machinery or related product itself or by gases, liquids, dust, vapours or other substances produced or used by the machinery or related product.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.7
statements.object: risk of explosion due to its use in a potentially explosive atmosphere
statements.object_as_written: risk of explosion due to its use in a potentially explosive atmosphere
statements.object_normalised: risk of explosion due to its use in a potentially explosive atmosphere
statements.quote: Machinery or related products shall comply, as far as the risk of explosion due to its use in a potentially explosive atmosphere is concerned, with the provisions of the specific Union harmonisation legislation.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.9
statements.object: risks resulting from vibrations produced by the machinery or related product
statements.object_as_written: risks resulting from vibrations produced by the machinery or related product
statements.object_normalised: risks resulting from vibrations produced by the machinery or related product
statements.quote: Vibrations Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that risks resulting from vibrations produced by the machinery or related product are reduced to the lowest level, taking account of technical progress and the availability of means of reducing vibration, in particular at source.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.12
statements.object: accidental radiation
statements.object_as_written: accidental radiation
statements.object_normalised: accidental radiation
statements.quote: Laser radiation Where laser equipment is used, the following shall be taken into account: (a) laser equipment on machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent any accidental radiation; (b) laser equipment on machinery or related products shall be protected in such a way that effective radiation, radiation produced by reflection or diffusion and secondary radiation do not damage health; (c) optical equipment for the observation or adjustment of laser equipment on machinery or related products shall be such that no health risk is created by laser radiation.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.13
statements.object: risks of inhalation
statements.object_as_written: risks of inhalation
statements.object_normalised: risks of inhalation
statements.quote: Emissions of hazardous materials and substances Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that risks of inhalation, ingestion, contact with the skin, eyes and mucous membranes and penetration through the skin of hazardous materials and substances which it produces can be avoided.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.14
statements.object: Risk of being trapped in a machine
statements.object_as_written: Risk of being trapped in a machine
statements.object_normalised: risk of being trapped in a machine
statements.quote: Risk of being trapped in a machine Machinery or related products shall be designed, constructed or fitted with a means of preventing a person from being enclosed within it or, if that is impossible, with a means of summoning help.

statements.subject: essential requirement 1.5.15
statements.object: Risk of slipping
statements.object_as_written: Risk of slipping
statements.object_normalised: risk of slipping
statements.condition: where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping
statements.quote: Risk of slipping, tripping or falling Parts of the machinery or related product where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling on or off these parts.

statements.condition: where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping
statements.quote: Risk of slipping, tripping or falling Parts of the machinery or related product where persons are liable to move about or stand shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons slipping, tripping or falling on or off these parts.

statements.condition_quote: Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 2. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X.
